PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: AP63203WU-7 assigns EN (EN) whereas TPS563201DDCR assigns SW (SW) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 4: AP63203WU-7 assigns GND (GND) whereas TPS563201DDCR assigns VFB (FB) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 5: AP63203WU-7 assigns SW (SW) whereas TPS563201DDCR assigns EN (EN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: Synchronous rectification eliminates external Schottky diode loss and PCB area.
Compact WSON/VSON/SOT-563 packages demand tight hot-loop layout and thermal vias.
Verify cold-start minimum startup voltage and bus surge ceiling.
Provides transient overshoot margin above nominal DC supply bus.
Fixed-output variants save divider BOM; adjustable parts allow arbitrary rail tuning.
For boost converters, usable Iout ≈ Isw × (Vin / Vout) × η minus half ripple ΔIL/2.
Dominates light-load efficiency and standby battery runtime.
Higher fsw shrinks inductor footprint; lower fsw reduces switching losses & high-band EMI.
Check datasheet efficiency curve at your exact Vin/Vout/Iout operating point.
Ensure inductor Isat exceeds worst-case peak switch current by >= 20–30%.
Any Vref discrepancy requires recalculating feedback divider R1/R2.
Lower θJA improves continuous load thermal headroom on compact 2-layer PCBs.

swap_risks: CAUTION PACKAGE HEIGHT/PROFILE: AP63203WU-7 (TSOT-23-6) vs TPS563201DDCR (SOT-23-6) share the same JEDEC land pattern pitch, but thin-profile TSOT (~1.0 mm) vs standard SOT (~1.45 mm) differs in body height; verify enclosure Z-clearance, SMT nozzle height, and solder fillet spec.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs SW), Pin 4 (GND vs FB), Pin 5 (SW vs EN). Soldering TPS563201DDCR onto a AP63203WU-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 47% (AP63203WU-7: 1100 kHz p.5 vs TPS563201DDCR: 580 kHz p.6); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP63203WU-7: 3.9 µH p.13 vs TPS563201DDCR: 2.2 µH p.15); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH FEEDBACK CONFIGURATION: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; external R1/R2 feedback resistors and feedforward capacitor must be updated.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (AP63203WU-7: 32 V p.4 vs TPS563201DDCR: 17 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP63203WU-7 specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS563201DDCR 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
engineering_verdict: AP63203WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and TPS563201DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs SW), Pin 4 (GND vs FB), Pin 5 (SW vs EN). Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency is 1100 kHz (p.5) vs 580 kHz (p.6), rated current is 2000 mA (p.1) vs 3000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 3.9 µH (p.13) vs 2.2 µH (p.15), and Iq is 22 µA (p.5) vs 120 µA (p.6). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 89 vs 92.6 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
